obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Primary page background, hero canvas, image void — the default stage everything sits on

midnight.$description: Midnight — Hero ambient and large image containers — a near-black with the faintest blue undertone that keeps the void from looking flat

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Elevated card surfaces, hover state for ghost buttons, secondary panels that need to lift off Obsidian

graphite.$description: Graphite — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

iron.$description: Iron — Muted body text, inactive icon strokes, decorative dividers in dense blocks

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary supporting text, caption-level annotations, tertiary iconography

ash.$description: Ash — Tertiary text, helper copy, less-prominent metadata

fog.$description: Fog — Secondary body text and sub-labels that still need readability over dark surfaces

pearl.$description: Pearl — Hairline borders, subtle stroke dividers, ghost button outlines

mist.$description: Mist — Light divider lines on dark surfaces where higher contrast isn't needed

cloud.$description: Cloud — Light surface reserved for inverted sections or content blocks that demand brightness

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Light supporting surface for subtle backgrounds and section separation. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

suisse-intl.$description: The only typeface in the system. Used for every interface element: nav, body, buttons, hero, pricing, footer. Display weights 500–600 at 48–96px with aggressive -0.025em tracking create the compressed, cinematic headline feel; the unusual 450 weight handles editorial body emphasis without crossing into semibold territory.
